notes.title: 🎉 The Music Festival DLC is Out Now! 🎶Plus a Mini Words Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/43160692fda946210ccfacf50e404c8ba30638f6.jpg[/img]
Hey everyone!
We're thrilled to announce that the [b]Meow Moments: Music Festival DLC[/b] is now available on Steam! 🐾

🎸 Step into a vibrant open-air celebration where cats and friends gather to enjoy pop, rock, folk, and electronic music. Explore themed stages, cozy camping spots, a dazzling Ferris wheel, and much more — all illustrated by Katia Numakura and set to a chill, festive soundtrack by Tatyana Jacques.

👉 Add it to your game and keep the celebration going!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3802160/Meow_Moments_Music_Festival/

[h1]🎮 Mini Words Gets an Update Too![/h1]
That’s not all!
We’ve just released a new update for our word puzzle game, [b]Mini Words[/b] 🎉

🕹️ Now with Gamepad Support – play comfortably with a controller
☁️ Steam Cloud Enabled – keep your progress across devices

If you enjoy relaxed logic word games, it’s a great time to check it out!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158290/Mini_Words__minimalist_puzzle/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/828263e2b7a80914de85a50656214af06ef90ce6.png[/img]

Thank you for supporting our cozy games! We hope you enjoy this new DLC and the updates across our catalog.

tags.feature: Now with Gamepad Support – play comfortably with a controller

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Fixes an issue in the last update (today) where the information in cloud save was not being restored properly.
This update restores the last position from the cloud before the update, and unlocks the levels according to the player achievements.

Thank you for playing the game, and sorry for the inconvenience.

Best regards

notes.title: Update! Gamepad and keyboard controls to celebrate the news!
notes.content:
Hi, in this update we include [b]Gamepad and Keyboard controls[/b]. 

In addition to the current mouse controls, now you have the option to use a gamepad or the keyboard to navigate the menus, build the island and control the camera. Try it!

We recently released the game on Nintendo Switch, which required the gamepad controls. So, we brought this option to the Steam players too. Steam Deck players will greatly benefit from it. 
We hope you enjoy it!

Island Cities is now available on Steam, Nintendo Switch, Epic Games Store and Stove Indie. We could reach that thanks to the support from players like you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790598/6e39a8b276963b45f83dbfa2b7e79cf7e11a66e1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790598/baf94ddfda7347d8a89b9e737004a608a503abb8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790598/892be0c767d8460d0a6b390c43b386a3077ecf5d.jpg[/img]

In addition, many of our other games are in the [b]Steam Puzzle Fest[/b], at discount. Take the opportunity to complete your collection! More details at this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2093900/old_view/3730711815891131065]link[/url].
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/5a8324f61a7c5f1c6711e1705a35adda94851029.gif[/img]

Follow our Steam developer's page to keep track of our updates:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/menssana

notes.title: Happy Holidays Update! Night Environment
notes.content:
[b]Merry Christmas and Happy New Year[/b] to our island cities dwellers!
To celebrate this occasion, we are introducing [b]the brand-new night environment, with two new islands[/b].
The cities are even prettier with the street lights, illuminated houses and buildings. Great for a night walks and rides with friends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790598/2d2a25dd20d1d62a78398efa82458a0c1ad58855.jpg[/img]

The update is [b]free [/b]for everyone who already has the game. We hope you enjoy it!

Thank you for playing the game and for your support!
More to come in 2023… 
Follow the game page and our Steam developer’s page to keep track of our news!
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/menssana

tags.feature: the brand-new night environment, with two new islands

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hi, folks!
This update includes:
- Clicking blocks is more agile now. You no longer have to wait for the previous move to finish.
- Short introductory text to tell the objective of the game in the first level.
- Some bug fixes!

Thank you so much for playing Island Cities!
Please continue to post your feedback and suggestions in the Community Hub to help us deliver an even better experience.
